work_completed: Task 1 (path-traversal-safe storage): src/continuity.ts wrote a raw `${userId}.json` filename, so a user_id like '../../etc/passwd' escaped the storage dir in the PUBLISHED @neurolift-technologies/sleepwalker-protocol package. Mirrored the Python ContinuityManager._user_file: filenames are now derived from a SHA-256 of the full user_id (filesystem-safe hex) prefixed with a sanitized human-readable slug. Traversal-safe and collision-safe. Also restored declaredBoundaries persistence and declaredBoundaries/sessionCount in getContext to match Python semantics.

Task 2 (user_id continuity keying): src/protocol.ts assessInteraction never consulted the continuity manager. Added a stable instance user_id (constructor `userId` option, then a TOI-declared user_id, then 'default_user'), an optional userId arg on assessInteraction, a continuityContext keyed on that id (never the message text), and a maintainContinuity write method — matching the Python protocol.py parity landed in PR #6.

Task 3 (license metadata drift): pyproject.toml and sleepwalker_protocol/__init__.py declared MIT while LICENSE + package.json are Apache-2.0. Updated both Python metadata declarations to Apache-2.0 (license field + the OSI classifier). Did NOT touch the LICENSE file.

Tests: added TS regression tests in tests/continuity.test.ts (traversal containment via hashed filename; slug-collision separation) and tests/protocol.test.ts (continuity keyed on user_id not message text; per-user isolation across instances). Updated the one existing continuity test that read a raw 'user-1.json' filename to read through the public API instead.

Negative control: temporarily reverted continuity.ts to the raw-filename version and confirmed the traversal test FAILS (it attempts to write outside the storage root to /tmp/etc/passwd.json), proving the test exercises the fix. Restored the hardened version.
Verification: npx tsc --noEmit clean (exit 0); npm run build clean; jest 29 passed (was 24, +5 new); python pytest 46 passed (was 46, no collateral from the license change).
Compliance: registered this session and wrote this handoff per AGENTS.md / OTOI; updated docs/active-threads.md.
decisions_made: Mirrored the Python hashing scheme exactly (slug[:32] of [A-Za-z0-9_-] chars, fallback 'user', plus a full sha256 hex) so on-disk layout and isolation guarantees match across the two ports.
Kept the read/write separation: assessInteraction reads continuity, maintainContinuity persists it — no implicit disk write on assessment, consistent with the privacy posture and the Python side.
Default instance user_id is 'default_user' so a single SWP instance keeps continuity across calls even when callers do not pass an explicit id.
